newsitem.title: CHINA: South China Strategic to move domicile to Caymans.
newsitem.headline: South China Strategic to move domicile to Caymans.

text.p: South China Strategic Ltd said on Tuesday it would change the company's domicile by setting up a new holding company in the Cayman Islands to allow greater flexibility in future expansion plans.
The company said in a statement it would become an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of South China Strategic Investments Ltd, a company incorporated in the Cayman Islands.
The listing of South China Strategic shares would be withdrawn and replaced by South China Strategic Investment shares, it said.
Trading in shares of South China Strategic Ltd has been suspended since August 6.
